capabilities: Chat with your notes with cited answers
Search notes by meaning instead of keywords
Suggest and insert missing wikilinks between notes
Run inline writing commands (summarize, rewrite, fix grammar, expand) on selections
Fine-tune a small local model on your vault
extras: Requires installing and running a separate QVAC companion daemon (Node 20+); first-run model download is about 4.5 GB. Desktop only, will not load on Obsidian mobile. Manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
motivation: The author states the whole point is that your second brain never becomes someone else's training data.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in AI and its built-in search is keyword-only, so users had to rely on cloud services to ask questions of their notes.

relations.evidence: Same shape as plugins that use a local Ollama server.

summary: Local AI assistant that chats with your notes with citations, runs semantic search, suggests missing links, edits text, and OCRs images entirely on your machine.
